kill_fact: The single load-bearing fact of the value case — 'net cash ~$1.30B = ~60% of a ~$2.1B market cap, a ~$21/share floor' — is roughly DOUBLE the real number and does not verify against any primary filing. PRDO's FY-2025 10-K (filed 2026-02-19) reports cash + restricted cash + AFS short-term investments of $643.5M at 12/31/2025, and the Q1-2026 10-Q reports TOTAL liquidity (cash + restricted + short-term investments) of $680.0M at 3/31/2026 — NOT $1.30B-$1.36B. Against ~$105M total debt (incl. capital leases), real net cash is ~$575M, i.e. ~$9.2/share on 62.7M shares and ~27% of the $2.15B market cap, not 60%+ and not a $21/share floor. The '$1.30B net cash' is a ~2x double-count (the SoP overlay added back roughly twice the actual cash). This breaks the case: the bear SoP floor ($21/sh net cash), the base SoP (~$40 = ~$21 cash + ~$19 operating), and the headline '~3.6x EV/FCF ex its $1.3B cash' all collapse. Re-run with true net cash (~$9/sh): base SoP falls to ~$28-30 (operating ~$19 + cash ~$9) — i.e., at/below the $34 spot, so there is NO margin of safety and NO cash 'fortress.' The cheapness was manufactured by a doubled cash figure, on top of a real, dated Grad-PLUS headwind (eliminated July 1, 2026; graduate aggregate cap cut $138.5k->$100k) landing on the 19%-of-revenue, highest-multiple USAHS graduate segment.
corrections: (1) Net cash is ~$575M (~$9.2/share), NOT $1.30B (~$21/share) — total cash+investments is $680.0M at 3/31/2026 (10-Q) / $643.5M at 12/31/2025 (10-K), less ~$105M debt. The $1.30B-$1.36B figure is unverifiable and ~2x overstated. (2) Cash is ~27% of market cap, not '60%+'. (3) Ex-cash multiple is therefore NOT ~3.6x EV/FCF; with EV ~$2.15B - $0.575B = ~$1.58B on ~$217M FCF, ex-cash EV/FCF is ~7.3x, roughly double the claimed 3.6x. (4) The 'hard ~$21 net-cash floor / downside only ~12-18%' is wrong: true floor is ~$9/sh of cash plus the operating business, so the base SoP recomputes to ~$28-30 (at/below the $34 spot). (5) FY-2025 FCF of ~$217M (OCF $225.2M - capex $8.6M) and the Grad-PLUS timeline DO verify against primary sources — those bear points stand.
